aggregation: image macro over all 1000 records; failures retained
description: lexical only for initial assignment; final strict gpt-5.6-luna score / 5
failed_images: retain every image; unrecovered failed outputs contribute zero spatial F1
field_normalization: arithmetic mean of applicable reference fields; bbox, desc and type always apply; text and palette follow frozen applicability rules
parent_edge: global micro F1, including ROOT edges
partial_recovery: retain existing per-image recovered-node scoring and rejected-node denominators
spatial_aggregation: Arithmetic mean over 1000 images of pooled F1 across the four spatial relation types
type_score: 1 for equal concrete type; 0 otherwise; always applicable
undefined_per_image_f1: error; all 1000 reference images in this cohort have spatial relations
proximity_scoring: Positive Boolean is_near edges: F1=2TP/(2TP+FP+FN). False/false pairs do not earn credit.
spatial_selection: Evaluation reconstructs complete geometric relations from the benchmark node sets; the downloadable main dataset stores at most 100 selected spatial records per image.
